title: Split Reasons
statement: Implement `solve(duties)`. Each duty is `price` or `ship` or something else. Return `{"pricing": [...], "delivery": [...]}`. `price` goes to pricing. `ship` goes to delivery. Anything else is dropped. Order inside each list follows the input.
hints: Append price duties to pricing and ship duties to delivery.
Do not put a duty in both lists.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A class that both prices and ships has two reasons to change.

editorial: A class that both prices and ships has two reasons to change. Partitioning the duty list is the small version of that split. Dropping unknown words keeps a typo from landing in the wrong bucket silently. It is omitted, not guessed.
